offering_description.value: Provides skilled nursing, rehabilitation therapy, and assisted living to residents and patients who need post-acute or long-term care. Locally led affiliates deliver individualized care through interdisciplinary clinical teams.

quotes.quote: Ensign’s independent operating affiliates provide personalized post-acute and long-term care services guided by local leadership and delivered by clinicians committed to helping residents heal, regain independence, and thrive.
Ensign affiliates provide skilled nursing, rehabilitation, therapy, and assisted living services through a unique ONE CLINICAL approach.

primary_services.value: Skilled nursing; rehabilitation therapy; assisted living

quotes.quote: Ensign affiliates provide skilled nursing, rehabilitation, therapy, and assisted living services that leverage a ONE CLINICAL collaborative model of care focused on enhancing the lives of those they serve.

customer_segment.value: B2C: Residents and patients needing post-acute care, rehabilitation, or ongoing daily support

quotes.quote: Rather than treating individual conditions in isolation, Ensign-affiliated teams take a comprehensive view of residents’ health. By combining clinical expertise, compassionate caregiving, and evidence-based practices, residents obtain the support they need to recover from illness, regain function, maintain independence, and achieve their highest possible quality of life.

Ensign-affiliated entities operate across 18 states, and the footprint continues with a purpose: to extend the mission of local leadership, clinical excellence, and compassionate care to more communities. This growth has enabled local leaders and their interdisciplinary care teams to innovate and invest in best-practice solutions to continuously improve the quality of care they provide. As the number of affiliates increases, more residents, patients, and families have access to this unique, locally led model of care.
